gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Wire-cut and star-wide, Galaxy spreads its dense, tall lowercase across loose, open spacing. Noto Sans Adlam keeps its curve endings well apart and its c, s and z full and tall.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-old-persi: Noto Sans Old Persian stays open and lofty, with counters that breathe. Galaxy does its best work holding one constant thickness around every curve, while the body's strength is letting space in.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-sarpanch: Cosmic lines of one constant thickness, set loose and wide apart. Sarpanch, a sans with a clearly open e and compact ascenders, gives Galaxy a more approachable, contemporary counterweight.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-sofia-sans-semi-con: Cosmic is the mood of Galaxy, with loose spacing and a dense, tall lowercase band of constant line width. Sofia Sans Semi Condensed moves briskly, its lowercase nearly capital height.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-thai-loop: Funky and loose, Groovy nearly closes its c into a slit. Noto Sans Thai Looped, a sans with tall bodies and spacious curve endings, opens everything Groovy keeps shut.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-kufam: Heavy letters stand alone like beads on a rod in Impact Label, each c opening like a pair of pincers. Kufam traces everything in one neon-tube width, its sans curves generously open.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-lexend: Bead-like, commanding letters with open pincer-shaped c ends make Impact Label feel properly heavy and unmistakable. Lexend then lets the eye glide, thanks to outsized lowercase and open curves.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-nobile: Heavy beads on a rod: Impact Label stands alone, letter by letter. Nobile, a sans-serif with little gap between its lowercase and caps, would read steadily, open mouths like unjoined chalk arcs.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-noto-sans-mon: Commanding, heavy Impact Label sets each letter apart like a bead. Noto Sans Mono, its letters generously spaced and its lowercase tall, would make long paragraphs feel sturdy, never crowded.
